nodes.label: Craft Configuration Guide
nodes.rationale: config merged env vars > launchSettings > appsettings.{Environment}.json > appsettings.json; __ is the section separator; AzureWebJobsStorage required

nodes.label: Craft Split Deployment Roles
nodes.rationale: one image, three runtime-selected capabilities (Frontend/Http/Background) so cheap static frontend and compute-heavy PS backend scale independently; any explicit role flag makes unset roles default off, nothing set = monolith; orchestration trigger and processing must share a process (in-process queue), so http-only nodes cannot run orchestrations

nodes.label: PowerShell Worker Pool
nodes.rationale: separate HTTP and BG runspace pools; ReuseRunspaceThread default true is the biggest per-request dispatch win (~50% of PS-invoke cost, +68% throughput) matching Azure Functions' persistent runspace; ModuleInjections share Synchronized Hashtables across runspaces for token caches; first HTTP worker inits sequentially with WarmupScripts, the rest in parallel; ~100-200 MB per worker

nodes.label: Craft Auth Configuration
nodes.rationale: env var names intentionally match Azure App Service auth so the same config works whether Craft or the platform handles auth; three header scenarios (EasyAuth claims, SWA userRoles, session cookie) all normalize to one x-ms-client-principal format downstream; AllowAllTenantUsers=true admits any tenant user with default roles so the app can do its own role resolution

nodes.label: allowedUsers Table
nodes.rationale: Azure Table mapping UPN RowKey to JSON role array, mirrors Azure Static Web Apps user invitations; roles cached 5 min; can point at a separate storage account via Auth.UserStorageConnection to share one user table across instances

nodes.label: Craft Cron Scheduler
nodes.rationale: task definitions in a JSON file (e.g. CIPPTimers.json) with 6-field cron (seconds included), priority ordering, IsSystem tasks locked from UI disable; checks every CheckIntervalSeconds

nodes.label: Background Concurrency Limiter
nodes.rationale: starts narrow and ramps slowly to keep idle memory low; BackgroundBurstToCeiling jumps straight to the ceiling on fan-out bursts (~2.7x faster fan-out); HTTP-pressure throttle drops BG to 2 when HTTP workers are busy; keys live at config root, not under App:

nodes.label: Craft Orchestrator
nodes.rationale: fan-out/fan-in with crash recovery: Start-CraftOrchestrator bridges PS into C# OrchestratorService via OrchestratorBridge.QueueOrchestration; state persisted to Azure Tables after every change, interrupted tasks resume on restart; BatchStatusWrites batches status writes in <=100-entity transactions (the throughput fix for large fan-outs, results never batched); DurableRunningBarrier keeps the poison-task AttemptCount guarantee

nodes.label: Craft Response Cache
nodes.rationale: in-memory LRU over a disk cache for List* GET endpoints; defaults on only when a node serves both UI and API (combined/frontend+http), off otherwise; memory tier gain scales with response size (+44% small, +157% at ~150KB); scoped invalidation via tenantFilter

nodes.label: Realtime SSE Config
nodes.rationale: off by default; while off the endpoint is unmapped, Publish is a no-op, no state or timer held; when on, only Http or Frontend role nodes map /.craft/events
